name: @veren/forum-bundle
description: Use when a DSH profile needs the whole Forum stack (the durable Host service with its model-facing `forum_*` tools and the Web page) installed and composed in one step: it is a configuration-only bundle whose patch inserts the Host and Web-page rows in dependency order, it declares @veren/app-host-bundle as a dependency so the application framework's loader rows stay owned by that single bundle (never double-inserted when several application bundles coexist), and its member plugins ship as plain dependencies without bundle declarations of their own; skip it when you want only the Host service, or prefer composing these plugins row by row in your own patch.
_comment_dependencies: Member packages use workspace ranges, which is what a published bundle needs. The bundle also depends on @veren/app-host-bundle: that bundle owns every application-framework loader row, so the reconciliation installs the framework layer from this dependency instead of this patch re-inserting those rows (G1 dedup contract). A test node installs from local tarballs and its own pnpm run has no workspace to resolve `workspace:^` against, so scripts/repack.mjs rewrites the throwaway tarball's dependency entries to file: paths before the profile consumes it; the committed manifest stays registry-clean.
